name: WorkMesh
tagline: Docs-first project and task orchestration for developers and coding agents.

standalone_distribution.authority: Mesh monorepo; standalone repository is a generated snapshot

summary: WorkMesh keeps repo-local planning state next to code.
Primary human documentation lives in docs/README.md.
README.md is a short landing page with install and links.
The mesh monorepo root is the primary source of truth for active WorkMesh development.
WorkMesh discovers active task and epic Markdown files recursively under tasks/ for customer/project/application/feature organization.

monorepo.product_local_history_note: opt/workmesh/workmesh/ is retained as WorkMesh-owned project/history content inside the monorepo, not as a separate repository.

entry_prompts: Bootstrap WorkMesh in this repo. Use MCP if available, otherwise CLI.

Use WorkMesh for this feature end to end. Create/update PRD, create and maintain tasks with acceptance criteria and definition of done, keep context current, and track stable decisions in Truth Ledger.
workflow.resume_prompt: Rehydrate this session with WorkMesh. Read current context, accepted truths, active workstream state, and next actionable tasks. Then summarize what I was doing, what constraints still apply, and the next concrete step.

skills.shared_doctrine: Each canonical skill bundles the same operating doctrine covering task quality, compaction-safe persistence, truth/note/task boundaries, and output rules.

rules.task_creation: By default, new actionable tasks must provide description, acceptance criteria, and definition of done. Use explicit draft mode for incomplete tasks. Repos can override the required task-quality fields in config.
rules.definition_of_done: By default, Definition of Done must be outcome-based, not hygiene-only. This requirement is configurable.
rules.mutation_responses: Compact by default; use verbose=true only when richer post-write state is required.
resume_checklist: read accepted truths for current scope
inspect workstream restore state if parallel work exists
identify the active task or smallest valid working set
summarize current objective, constraints, and next step before new implementation work
rules.task_directory_organization: Active task and epic Markdown files may be nested under tasks/ by customer, project, application/service, initiative, or feature. Directory paths are human navigation only; id, kind, parent, dependencies, labels, phase, and status front matter remain the source of truth.
rules.archive_structure: Archive writes use archive/<yyyy>/<mm>/<status>/<relative-task-path>. Date comes first, status is normalized, and the original path below tasks/ is preserved; legacy archive/YYYY-MM files remain readable.
